relations.verbe: vetoes any AI-employee contract lacking decision-support + human-validation framing
relations.citation: Autonomous agents have no legal personhood — the operator is liable. An autonomous software agent is not a legal person and cannot be a mandataire binding the entity. The operating entity bears full liability for every agent action; CGV must define the agent as a decision-support tool, never a legal mandatary, and mandate human final validation on sensitive outputs (hallucination risk → never warrant 100% accuracy). Track EU AI-Act risk-tier obligations + robotics compliance (ROS2) where physical agents apply.

relations.verbe: documents human inventive contribution for AI-discovered IP

When AI discovers a material/molecule/design (GNoME-class, via graph neural networks), patent inventorship is contested — USPTO/Thaler-DABUS: an AI cannot be a named inventor. Document the human inventive contribution, file fast, and treat AI-discovered IP as a sovereign asset to protect (not assume). Nature/known science = prior art.

Model reinvestment assuming this deflation; don't lock long contracts to today's token cost.
